name: Dardel (PDC, KTH)
notes: Use your NAISS project as the Slurm account, for example naiss2026-1-123.
Dardel nodes have 128 cores; the main partition allocates whole nodes.
Run `ml spider vasp` on Dardel to see the installed VASP modules, then adjust the setup commands.
Put runs under /cfs/klemming/scratch or your project folder. Detect from cluster fills these in.
